title: Listener back-channel edits of a class recording (source file, not published)
description: data/edits/<encoded lecture id>.json, written by data/retime (`backchannel detect`, then `backchannel render` fills in `output`). Each edit is a span of the original audio replaced by room tone (fill mode: the edited file has the same duration, so every timestamp stays valid). The data build also checks the file name, that the lecture and transcript exist, that `transcriptSha` matches the transcript, and that the edits are in order, do not overlap and lie inside the audio.

mode.description: Edits replace audio with room tone; nothing is cut.

transcript.description: Path of the stored transcript, relative to data/.

transcriptSha.description: transcriptSha of the transcript the detection used (as in retimed.schema.json).

wordTimes.description: Which word times bracketed the transcript's "Right."s.

method.description: Detector name, version, thresholds and models.

source.description: The original recording the edits apply to.

edits.description: Spans replaced by room tone, in order, seconds in the original audio.

class.description: isolated: in a pause; overlap: touches the teacher's speech.

action.description: fill: the whole span; partial-fill: the part of an overlap outside the teacher's speech.

src.description: What found it: audio (an energy burst), audio+tx, or tx (a transcript "Right.").

kept.description: Candidates left alone, with the reason (for review).

output.description: The rendered file (null until rendered). It is uploaded next to the original as `filename`.

editsSha.description: sha256 of the edits' start, end and action the file was rendered from.
